Make a resume point: play from the beginning and press Back at about 2:58. On a film, play past 6% of the runtime instead (about 7:00 on a 110 min film): the server saves a position only after 5% of the runtime. The item page must then show Resume; choose it. If it shows only Play, no position was saved. Check the path: the expected delivery is Remux a:copy. Until deadfin#635 ships, the Session panel Method reads Direct Play for every SharkParty session, so it does not prove the path: note the clock time you pressed Play, and the path is confirmed from the server ingress log. After deadfin#635, swipe down on the touch surface during play and open Session: Method must read Remux. If it reads anything else, the wrong player, setting or track is active: stop, fix the setup, and do not record a result.
